{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm that there are no rows with revenue = '999999.99'
print("Rows with revenue == '999999.99':", len(df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']))

# Check if any of these are in the 'loyal' segment
qa_in_loyal = df[(df['revenue'] == '999999.99') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')]
print("QA rows in loyal segment:", len(qa_in_loyal))"}
